record.title: Record the absent enforcement file without changing specimen policy
record.intent: Preserve actual policy-file availability while removing an unsupported collector assumption.
requirements: Preserve current-03 stopped evidence: UID0 and stock package/corpus reads precede a literal missing-file error at /sys/fs/selinux/enforce. Keep capture statistics and ordered helper retirement. No policy reader, native transition or source command occurred.

Amend only the read-only enforcement-file observation to distinguish a readable zero or one from confirmed path absence. Reject unreadable existing files, symlinks, malformed values and failed commands. Absence is an observation, not a claim that policy is disabled. Preserve exact before/after comparison and make no policy change.
Use supplied-file controls and independent review, bind exact new runtime hashes to a fresh collector identity, and commit and push before execution. Preserve all prior seals and specimen originals.
acceptance: The collector represents observed enforcement-file absence without weakening unchanged-state verification.
